verdict.rationale: Adyen Issuing documents a clear webhook subscription model, listing webhook types (Configuration, Payment method, Transfer, Dispute, Negative balance warning, Report) and detailed relayed-authorisation webhooks with response-time and fallback logic. This is standard event-driven integration usable by any automated/agentic system. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of webhook reliability and no explicit mention of AI-agent-specific tooling around webhook consumption.
